```python
def partial_trace(X, sys, dim):
    # Get the permutation: systems to keep (not traced out) first, then traced-out systems
    keep = [i for i in range(len(dim)) if i not in sys]
    trace = [i for i in range(len(dim)) if i in sys]
    
    # Permute X so that kept systems come first, traced-out systems come last
    perm = keep + trace
    permuted_X = syspermute(X, perm, dim)
    
    # Get dimensions of kept systems (result dimension)
    keep_dim = [dim[i] for i in keep]
    result_dim = np.prod(keep_dim)
    
    # Get dimensions of traced-out systems
    traced_dim = [dim[i] for i in trace]
    
    # Total dimension after permutation
    total_dim = np.prod(dim)
    
    # Reshape to separate kept and traced dimensions
    reshape_shape = keep_dim + traced_dim
    reshaped = permuted_X.reshape(reshape_shape)
    
    # Trace over the traced dimensions
    # For each traced dimension, sum over its axis
    for i in range(len(traced_dim)):
        # The axis to trace is len(keep_dim) + i
        reshaped = np.trace(reshaped, axis1=len(keep_dim) + i, axis2=len(keep_dim) + i + 1)
    
    # Reshape back to 2D
    result = reshaped.reshape((result_dim, result_dim))
    
    return result
```
